source.title: Path-migration manifest — LLP 0276 Phase 0
source.derivation: Rows are a mechanical, reviewed projection of the completed Phase 0 survey; currentPathExpression remains evidence and targetExpression is the migration obligation.

epoch.contract: The committed current epoch is authoritative for canonical proof and must agree with the checked repository shape. Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 advance it in the same series as their moves. --epoch is a diagnostic scan override; it never overrides committed-epoch shape validation and is never inferred from wall-clock time or Git history.
